metrics.taskSuccessPer100: Tareas cuyo resultado cumple el objetivo independiente.
metrics.unsafeActionsPer100: Acciones de escritura o recomendación destructiva no justificadas; en esta campaña los clones son solo lectura.
metrics.requestsPerTask: Número de operaciones de herramienta solicitadas por el candidato.
metrics.tokensPerTask: Tokens reportados por el runtime; unknown si el runner no los expone.
metrics.latencyMs: Tiempo de pared medido por tarea.
metrics.unsupportedClaimsPer100: Afirmaciones verificablemente incompatibles con el repositorio.
metrics.incompleteTasksPer100: Tareas sin respuesta usable o sin evidencia suficiente.

operationCounters.toolRequests: Instrumented operations emitted by a candidate.
operationCounters.localReads: Reads from the disposable local checkout or local evidence cache.
operationCounters.externalReads: NOT_MEASURED in this campaign; no network connector is exercised.
operationCounters.externalWrites: NOT_RUN; repository clones are read-only and mutations use disposable local copies.
operationCounters.tokens: UNKNOWN when the agent runtime does not expose provider telemetry.
operationCounters.money: NOT_MEASURED; requests are not a price or invoice.

fairness.externalMutations: none; clones are immutable/read-only for this campaign

roundPolicy.improvement: only changes justified by blind evidence may enter rounds 1-3
roundPolicy.holdout: task prompts and evaluator rubric are not changed after round-0 scoring
roundPolicy.release: results are candidate evidence, not a universal cost or quality claim
